onTime.title: Delivered when I said

real.title: Real, not a demo
real.body: Something your team uses on a normal Tuesday. Deployed, documented, and handed over with everything it needs to keep running.

custom.title: Built for your problem
custom.body: Your workflow is not a template, so the solution isn't either. I start from what your business actually does, not from a tutorial.

support.title: I don't disappear
support.body: Handoff isn't the end of the conversation. You get support after delivery, and a person who still answers their email.

services.metaDescription: Roya Vosoughi's AI services: group training, consulting sessions, automation, custom agents and multi-agent systems.
services.title: From one training session to a team of agents.
services.intro: Five ways to make AI actually work in your business. Pick the one closest to your problem and send a request.

training.name: Training Course
training.problem: What people know about AI is scattered and missing the details that matter, so they don't get the results they want.
training.deliverable: A document of engineered prompts and the step-by-step process of a sample project, plus the session recording.

consulting.name: Consulting Session
consulting.for: A manager, or an employee, who wants to start using AI.
consulting.problem: They don't know what improvements AI could bring to their work.
consulting.deliverable: A 30–45 minute session reviewing your workflow, then a written proposal of opportunities and solutions a few days later.
consulting.duration: One session plus a few working days.
consulting.price: Set after the introductory meeting or once the proposal is ready.

automation.name: Automation
automation.for: Anyone who has to do the same set of repetitive tasks every day.
automation.problem: A lot of time goes into that repetitive workflow, every single day.
automation.deliverable: An automated system that does those tasks for you at a set time each day.
automation.duration: From a few weeks up to several months, including support.

agent.name: Agent Creation
agent.for: Anyone for whom one process takes several days to complete.
agent.problem: Every step of the task has to be checked personally.
agent.deliverable: An agent that checks every detail of the process in line with your personal brand, and gets your approval.

multiAgent.name: Multi-Agent
multiAgent.for: Clients happy with their automation and agent who want to go further.
multiAgent.deliverable: Several agents with independent tasks, and a manager agent for final approval.

about.title: I'm Roya.
about.p1: I'm an AI engineer and software developer. I design and build applications powered by large language models — RAG systems, assistants and agents that take on a specific, measurable job inside a business.
about.p2: My focus is the gap between an impressive demo and a dependable product: answers grounded in your own data, sensible limits on what the AI decides alone, clear documentation, and support after handoff. Every project starts with your problem, not the technology.
about.quote: Built to be used, not just shown.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Roya Vosoughi — AI engineer and software developer building reliable LLM-powered applications, assistants and agents for businesses.
aboutPage.title: I turn large language models into tools businesses rely on.
aboutPage.lead: AI engineer and software developer. I design, build and support LLM-powered applications that do a specific, useful job — and keep doing it after handoff.
aboutPage.p1: My work is mostly applications powered by LLMs: retrieval systems that answer questions from a company's own documents, assistants that handle a repetitive task properly, and agents that know the limits of what they should decide alone.
aboutPage.p2: I have one rule that shapes everything: build in public. Every project is deployed, open source and documented. That is partly discipline — it is much harder to cut a corner when the repository is open — and partly the fastest way to show what I can do without asking anyone to take my word for it.
aboutPage.p3: I graduated from Politecnico di Torino in AI and Software Engineering.

punctual.name: Punctuality
punctual.body: The project arrives when I said it would. Your time is the one thing I cannot give back to you.

practical.name: Practicality
practical.body: A solution that works in the business, not a demo that works in a meeting.

creative.name: Creativity
creative.body: A specific answer to your specific problem, rather than last project's answer with the name changed.

inspiring.name: Possibility
inspiring.body: I want you to leave knowing what AI could do for you — including, honestly, when the answer is not much.

aboutPage.ctaBody: Tell me what the problem is. If I'm not the right person for it, I'll say so and point you somewhere better.
